name: Crown Jewel
text: Affinity: Spade. When this card wins a trick, gain +25 contract value.
archetypes: Spade Master; splash High Card, Bonus Chaser
decision: When to cash the spade: a high spade wins once its suit is safe, and a low one waits for a void to trump into.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents can trump the ace to deny it.
aiNote: Lead the engraved ace early in a suit opponents still hold.
rationale: A random spade wins about 45% of the time, so this is about 9 expected points per round, with a wide spread: an ace of spades nearly always pays, and a low spade pays only if you open a void to trump with it.
deviation: Affinity changed from Ace to Spade, so the engraved card varies from hand to hand and the decision of how to make it win varies with it.
